description: An Apache Beam batch pipeline that reads dump files created from BigQuery, and writes into Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL
name: PostgreSQL Replication Importer

parameters.helpText: Provide the batch size to write to PostgreSQL (default is 500).
parameters.label: Batch size
parameters.name: batchSize

parameters.helpText: Provide the name of the CloudSQL connection.
parameters.label: CloudSQL Connection Name
parameters.name: cloudSQLConnectionName

parameters.helpText: Provide the name of database in the CloudSQL instance to run in (default is osbasah).
parameters.label: Database Name
parameters.name: databaseName

parameters.helpText: Provide the database user to use in the CloudSQL instance.
parameters.label: Database User
parameters.name: databaseUser

parameters.helpText: Provide the max number of connections to data source (default is 3).
parameters.label: Data Source Max Connections
parameters.name: datasourceMaxConnections

parameters.helpText: Provide a comma separated list of column names corresponding to the fields in the CSV files.
parameters.label: Individual Activity Columns
parameters.name: individualActivityColumns

parameters.helpText: Provide the input directory of individual activity data.
parameters.label: Individual Activity Input Directory
parameters.name: individualActivityInputDirectory

parameters.helpText: Provide a comma separated list of column names used as primary key.

parameters.name: individualActivityPrimaryKey

parameters.label: Individual Interest Columns

parameters.name: individualInterestInputDirectory

parameters.label: Individual Interest Primary Key

parameters.helpText: Provide a comma separated list of column names used as primary key.
